notes: Single reported operating segment: cigarettes and smoke-free tobacco/nicotine products (99.6% of revenue). SETC figures are cumulative since 2007. PT Sampoerna Karya Bangsa changed its business activity to job training provider in March 2025 and is a small subsidiary by assets. The SRC MoUs with five state-owned enterprises (financial services, food, LPG, logistics and broadband access points) were signed in 2025 but are phrased as future ('will serve'), so they were treated as planned and not scored. The SFP partnership program (600 MSMEs) and the 43 TPOs owned by local entrepreneurs are distribution and contract-manufacturing relationships for the company's own products (serving), so they were not scored as enabling. The Agricultural Partnership Program for 22,500 farmers is supply-chain sourcing and was not scored. 'Community engagement' in marketing was treated as a trap. Employee demographics (12,667 female employees) are disclosure only. The Ethics & Compliance department substantiated 36 of 95 reports, but their type (e.g. harassment or discrimination) is not disclosed, so no rights_finding was listed. The child labor prevention commitment is policy only. The report states that AI tools were used in drafting.
